slides.title: Overview of Type Traits
slides.prompt: The <type_traits> header provides compile-time tools to inspect, query, and modify type properties. They enable type introspection and meta-programming choices at compile time.

slides.title: Checking Type Equality
slides.prompt: Fill in the type trait used to check if two types are identical.

slides.title: Value Suffix (_v) vs Type Traits
options: A variable template shortcut for std::is_floating_point<T>::value
A function pointer returning a boolean value
An inline function evaluating type at runtime
slides.correctAnswer: A variable template shortcut for std::is_floating_point<T>::value

slides.title: Removing Reference Trait
slides.prompt: Fill in the trait modifier used to strip reference qualifiers from type T.
slides.codeSnippet: using CleanType = typename std::___<int&>::type; // CleanType is int

slides.title: std::decay Purpose
slides.prompt: What modifications does std::decay apply to a type T?
options: Removes const/volatile/reference qualifiers and converts array/function types to pointers
slides.correctAnswer: Removes const/volatile/reference qualifiers and converts array/function types to pointers

slides.title: Conditional Type Selection
slides.prompt: Fill in the type trait that selects between TypeA and TypeB based on a boolean condition.
slides.codeSnippet: using SelectedType = std::___<true, int, double>::type; // int

slides.title: Primary Type Categories
slides.prompt: Which trait tests if a type is a non-union class or struct type?

slides.title: Checking Base Class Relationship
slides.prompt: Fill in the type trait checking if Base is a base class of Derived.

slides.title: std::integral_constant Inheritance
slides.prompt: What base classes do std::true_type and std::false_type derive from?
options: They are basic primitive typedefs without inheritance

slides.title: Checking No-throw Construction
slides.prompt: Fill in the trait verifying if type T has a non-throwing default constructor.
